blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — Tyler Herro let his final shot of the game fly and — just as the Bucks guard had felt throughout his career-best game — thought it was good. LeBron James assumed Herro would make the tying bucket, and force overtime. “Just the way he was playing and the way his shot-making was tonight, I was like, ‘It’s going in,’” James said. READ: NBA: LeBron James, 76ers snap Magic’s four-game streak The Sixers star had one more thought in the moment as the final seconds ticked off the clock. “And hopefully he didn’t get it off in time,” James said.
